46-21-01B.t: Air Traffic Service Unit (procedures require ATC datalink)
46-21-01B.txt:
FLIGHT PLANNING RESTRICTIONS
      ‐ ATC datalink communications (ADS-C, CPDLC, DCL, OCL, and D-ATIS) are not available.
        Associated ATC datalink Required Communication / Surveillance Performance (RCP / Initial
        Continental Performance for CPDLC and RSP for ADS-C) capabilities are lost.
        For more information on aircraft capability on ATC datalink communication, Refer to
        FCOM/DSC-46-10-10 Overview.
      ‐ As an alternate procedure, ATC may permit the use of voice communication on alternate route
        that does not require FANS A aircraft capability.
      ‐ ATC permits the use of the voice communication for operations that require FANS B aircraft
        capability.
      ‐ For aircraft with the 4D Operations capability, 4D Operations are not permitted.
      COMPANY Datalink transmissions may be inoperative. Refer to Item 46-21-05 COMPANY
      Datalink
   FLIGHT CREW
      Contact dispatcher for flight release update and “FLIGHT PLANNING RESTRICTIONS”
      confirmation.


                                                 Datalink Control and Display Unit (DCDU)
46-21-01B.ko:
FLIGHT PLANNING RESTRICTIONS (비행계획 제한)
‐ ATC datalink 통신(ADS-C, CPDLC, DCL, OCL, D-ATIS)을 사용할 수 없다.
관련 ATC datalink Required Communication / Surveillance Performance(RCP / CPDLC용 Initial Continental Performance 및 ADS-C용 RSP) 능력이 상실된다.
ATC datalink 통신에 관한 항공기 능력의 자세한 내용은 FCOM/DSC-46-10-10 Overview 참조.
‐ 대체 절차로서, ATC는 FANS A 항공기 능력이 요구되지 않는 대체 항로에서 음성 통신(voice communication) 사용을 허가할 수 있다.
‐ FANS B 항공기 능력이 요구되는 운항에 대해서는 ATC가 음성 통신 사용을 허가한다.
‐ 4D Operations 능력이 있는 항공기의 경우, 4D Operations는 허용되지 않는다.
COMPANY Datalink 전송이 작동 불능일 수 있다. Item 46-21-05 COMPANY Datalink 참조
FLIGHT CREW (운항승무원 조치)
flight release 갱신과 "FLIGHT PLANNING RESTRICTIONS" 확인을 위해 dispatcher(운항관리사)에게 연락한다.
